answer: Bonded identity escrow with a fraud window: each new agent deposits 120 POA into a contract that a velvet-rope whitelist cannot bypass, and the deposit stays locked 25 epochs. Any peer may post a 10 POA challenge proving two identities share a funder; if upheld, a mirror penalty burns 50% of both deposits and pays the challenger, so each extra fake costs more than the last. A bridge contract replays the evidence on-chain.
